versos.hebraico: מַ֝שְׂכִּ֗יל לְאֵיתָ֥ן הָֽאֶזְרָחִֽי׃
חַֽסְדֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה עוֹלָ֣ם אָשִׁ֑ירָה לְדֹ֥ר וָדֹ֓ר׀ אוֹדִ֖יעַ אֱמוּנָתְךָ֣ בְּפִֽי׃

controles.web: I will sing of the loving kindness of Yahweh forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.
controles.kjv: I will sing of the mercies of the Lord for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.
controles.livre: Cantarei das bondades do SENHOR para sempre; de geração em geração com minha boca anunciarei tua fidelidade.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־אָמַ֗רְתִּי ע֭וֹלָם חֶ֣סֶד יִבָּנֶ֑ה שָׁמַ֓יִם׀ תָּכִ֖ן אֱמוּנָתְךָ֣ בָהֶֽם׃

controles.web: I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”
controles.kjv: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.
controles.livre: Porque eu disse: Tua bondade durará para sempre; confirmaste tua fidelidade até nos céus.

versos.hebraico: כָּרַ֣תִּֽי בְ֭רִית לִבְחִירִ֑י נִ֝שְׁבַּ֗עְתִּי לְדָוִ֥ד עַבְדִּֽי׃

controles.web: “I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant,
controles.kjv: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,
controles.livre: Tu disseste : Eu fiz um pacto com o meu escolhido, jurei a meu servo Davi. Eu lhe disse :

versos.hebraico: עַד־ע֭וֹלָם אָכִ֣ין זַרְעֶ֑ךָ וּבָנִ֨יתִי לְדֹר־וָד֖וֹר כִּסְאֲךָ֣ סֶֽלָה׃

controles.web: ‘I will establish your seed forever, and build up your throne to all generations.’” Selah.
controles.kjv: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.
controles.livre: Confirmarei tua semente para sempre, e farei teu trono continuar de geração em geração. (Selá)

versos.hebraico: וְי֘וֹד֤וּ שָׁמַ֣יִם פִּלְאֲךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה אַף־אֱ֝מֽוּנָתְךָ֗ בִּקְהַ֥ל קְדֹשִֽׁים׃

controles.web: The heavens will praise your wonders, Yahweh; your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.
controles.kjv: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O Lord: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.
controles.livre: Que os céus louvem as tuas maravilhas, SENHOR; pois tua fidelidade está na congregação dos santos.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י מִ֣י בַ֭שַּׁחַק יַעֲרֹ֣ךְ לַיהוָ֑ה יִדְמֶ֥ה לַ֝יהוָ֗ה בִּבְנֵ֥י אֵלִים׃

controles.web: For who in the skies can be compared to Yahweh? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like Yahweh,
controles.kjv: For who in the heaven can be compared unto the Lord? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the Lord?
controles.livre: Porque quem no céu pode se comparar ao SENHOR? E quem é semelhante ao SENHOR entre os filhos dos poderosos?

versos.hebraico: אֵ֣ל נַ֭עֲרָץ בְּסוֹד־קְדֹשִׁ֣ים רַבָּ֑ה וְ֝נוֹרָ֗א עַל־כָּל־סְבִיבָֽיו׃

controles.web: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?
controles.kjv: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all them that are about him.
controles.livre: Deus é terrível na assembleia dos santos, e mais temível do que todos os que estão ao seu redor.

versos.hebraico: יְהוָ֤ה׀ אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י צְבָא֗וֹת מִֽי־כָֽמ֖וֹךָ חֲסִ֥ין׀ יָ֑הּ וֶ֝אֱמֽוּנָתְךָ֗ סְבִיבוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: Yahweh, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? Yah, your faithfulness is around you.
controles.kjv: O Lord God of hosts, who is a strong Lord like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?
controles.livre: Ó SENHOR Deus dos exércitos, quem é poderoso como tu, SENHOR? E tua fidelidade está ao redor de ti.

versos.hebraico: אַתָּ֣ה מ֭וֹשֵׁל בְּגֵא֣וּת הַיָּ֑ם בְּשׂ֥וֹא גַ֝לָּ֗יו אַתָּ֥ה תְשַׁבְּחֵֽם׃

controles.web: You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.
controles.kjv: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.
controles.livre: Tu dominas a arrogância do mar; quando suas ondas se levantam, tu as aquietas.

versos.hebraico: אַתָּ֤ה דִכִּ֣אתָ כֶחָלָ֣ל רָ֑הַב בִּזְר֥וֹעַ עֻ֝זְּךָ֗ פִּזַּ֥רְתָּ אוֹיְבֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.
controles.kjv: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.
controles.livre: Quebraste a Raabe como que ferida de morte; com teu braço forte espalhaste os teus inimigos.

versos.hebraico: לְךָ֣ שָׁ֭מַיִם אַף־לְךָ֥ אָ֑רֶץ תֵּבֵ֥ל וּ֝מְלֹאָ֗הּ אַתָּ֥ה יְסַדְתָּֽם׃

controles.web: The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours; the world and its fullness. You have founded them.
controles.kjv: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: as for the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.
controles.livre: Teus são os céus, também tua é a terra; o mundo e sua plenitude, tu os fundaste.

versos.hebraico: צָפ֣וֹן וְ֭יָמִין אַתָּ֣ה בְרָאתָ֑ם תָּב֥וֹר וְ֝חֶרְמ֗וֹן בְּשִׁמְךָ֥ יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃

controles.web: The north and the south, you have created them. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.
controles.kjv: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.
controles.livre: O norte e o sul, tu os criaste; Tabor e Hermon têm muita alegria em teu nome.

versos.hebraico: לְךָ֣ זְ֭רוֹעַ עִם־גְּבוּרָ֑ה תָּעֹ֥ז יָ֝דְךָ֗ תָּר֥וּם יְמִינֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: You have a mighty arm. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.
controles.kjv: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.
controles.livre: Tu tens um braço poderoso; forte é tua mão, e alta está tua mão direita.

versos.hebraico: צֶ֣דֶק וּ֭מִשְׁפָּט מְכ֣וֹן כִּסְאֶ֑ךָ חֶ֥סֶד וֶ֝אֱמֶ֗ת יְֽקַדְּמ֥וּ פָנֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.
controles.kjv: Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.
controles.livre: Justiça e juízo são a base de teu trono; bondade e verdade vão adiante de teu rosto.

versos.hebraico: אַשְׁרֵ֣י הָ֭עָם יוֹדְעֵ֣י תְרוּעָ֑ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה בְּֽאוֹר־פָּנֶ֥יךָ יְהַלֵּכֽוּן׃

controles.web: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O Lord, in the light of thy countenance.
controles.livre: Bem-aventurado é o povo que entende o grito de alegria; ó SENHOR, eles andarão na luz de tua face.

versos.hebraico: בְּ֭שִׁמְךָ יְגִיל֣וּן כָּל־הַיּ֑וֹם וּבְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ יָרֽוּמוּ׃

controles.web: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.
controles.kjv: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.
controles.livre: Em teu nome se alegrarão o dia todo, e em tua justiça serão exaltados.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־תִפְאֶ֣רֶת עֻזָּ֣מוֹ אָ֑תָּה וּ֝בִרְצֹנְךָ֗ תרים קַרְנֵֽנוּ׃

controles.web: For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.
controles.kjv: For thou art the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.
controles.livre: Porque tu és a glória de sua força, e por tua boa vontade nosso poder é exaltado.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י לַֽ֭יהוָה מָֽגִנֵּ֑נוּ וְלִקְד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל מַלְכֵּֽנוּ׃

controles.web: For our shield belongs to Yahweh; our king to the Holy One of Israel.
controles.kjv: For the Lord is our defence; and the Holy One of Israel is our king.
controles.livre: Porque ao SENHOR pertence nosso escudo; e o Santo de Israel é nosso Rei.

versos.hebraico: אָ֤ז דִּבַּ֥רְתָּֽ־בְחָ֡זוֹן לַֽחֲסִידֶ֗יךָ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר שִׁוִּ֣יתִי עֵ֭זֶר עַל־גִּבּ֑וֹר הֲרִימ֖וֹתִי בָח֣וּר מֵעָֽם׃

controles.web: Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, “I have bestowed strength on the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people.
controles.kjv: Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.
controles.livre: Então em visão falaste ao teu santo, e disseste: Pus o socorro sobre um valente; exaltei a um escolhido dentre o povo.

versos.hebraico: מָ֭צָאתִי דָּוִ֣ד עַבְדִּ֑י בְּשֶׁ֖מֶן קָדְשִׁ֣י מְשַׁחְתִּֽיו׃

controles.web: I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,
controles.kjv: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:
controles.livre: Achei a Davi, meu servo; eu o ungi com meu óleo santo.

versos.hebraico: אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָ֭דִי תִּכּ֣וֹן עִמּ֑וֹ אַף־זְרוֹעִ֥י תְאַמְּצֶֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.
controles.kjv: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.
controles.livre: Com ele minha mão será firme; e também meu braço o fortalecerá.

versos.hebraico: לֹֽא־יַשִּׁ֣א אוֹיֵ֣ב בּ֑וֹ וּבֶן־עַ֝וְלָ֗ה לֹ֣א יְעַנֶּֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.
controles.kjv: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.
controles.livre: O inimigo não tomará suas riquezas, nem o filho da perversidade o afligirá.

versos.hebraico: וְכַתּוֹתִ֣י מִפָּנָ֣יו צָרָ֑יו וּמְשַׂנְאָ֥יו אֶגּֽוֹף׃

controles.web: I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.
controles.kjv: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.
controles.livre: Porém eu espancarei seus adversários, e ferirei aos que o odeiam.

versos.hebraico: וֶֽאֶֽמוּנָתִ֣י וְחַסְדִּ֣י עִמּ֑וֹ וּ֝בִשְׁמִ֗י תָּר֥וּם קַרְנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.
controles.kjv: But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.
controles.livre: E minha fidelidade e minha bondade serão com ele; e em meu nome seu poder será exaltado.

versos.hebraico: וְשַׂמְתִּ֣י בַיָּ֣ם יָד֑וֹ וּֽבַנְּהָר֥וֹת יְמִינֽוֹ׃

controles.web: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.
controles.kjv: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.
controles.livre: Porei a mão dele no mar, e sua mão direita nos rios.

versos.hebraico: ה֣וּא יִ֭קְרָאֵנִי אָ֣בִי אָ֑תָּה אֵ֝לִ֗י וְצ֣וּר יְשׁוּעָתִֽי׃

controles.web: He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’
controles.kjv: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.
controles.livre: Ele me chamará: Tu és meu Pai, meu Deus, e a rocha da minha salvação.

versos.hebraico: אַף־אָ֭נִי בְּכ֣וֹר אֶתְּנֵ֑הוּ עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן לְמַלְכֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
controles.kjv: Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.
controles.livre: Eu também o porei como primogênito, mais alto que todos os reis da terra.

versos.hebraico: לְ֭עוֹלָ֗ם אשמור־ל֣וֹ חַסְדִּ֑י וּ֝בְרִיתִ֗י נֶאֱמֶ֥נֶת לֽוֹ׃

controles.web: I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more. My covenant will stand firm with him.
controles.kjv: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.
controles.livre: Manterei minha bondade para com ele para sempre, e meu pacto com ele será firme.

versos.hebraico: וְשַׂמְתִּ֣י לָעַ֣ד זַרְע֑וֹ וְ֝כִסְא֗וֹ כִּימֵ֥י שָׁמָֽיִם׃

controles.web: I will also make his seed endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
controles.kjv: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
controles.livre: Conservarei sua semente para sempre, e o trono dele como os dias dos céus.

versos.hebraico: אִם־יַֽעַזְב֣וּ בָ֭נָיו תּוֹרָתִ֑י וּ֝בְמִשְׁפָּטַ֗י לֹ֣א יֵלֵכֽוּן׃

controles.web: If his children forsake my law, and don’t walk in my ordinances;
controles.kjv: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;
controles.livre: Se seus filhos deixarem minha Lei, e não andarem em meus juízos,

versos.hebraico: אִם־חֻקֹּתַ֥י יְחַלֵּ֑לוּ וּ֝מִצְוֺתַ֗י לֹ֣א יִשְׁמֹֽרוּ׃

controles.web: if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;
controles.kjv: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;
controles.livre: Se profanarem os meus estatutos, e não guardarem os meus mandamentos,

versos.hebraico: וּפָקַדְתִּ֣י בְשֵׁ֣בֶט פִּשְׁעָ֑ם וּבִנְגָעִ֥ים עֲוֺנָֽם׃

controles.web: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
controles.kjv: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
controles.livre: Então punirei a transgressão deles com vara, e a perversidade deles com açoite,

versos.hebraico: וְ֭חַסְדִּי לֹֽא־אָפִ֣יר מֵֽעִמּ֑וֹ וְלֹֽא־אֲ֝שַׁקֵּ֗ר בֶּאֱמוּנָתִֽי׃

controles.web: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.
controles.kjv: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.
controles.livre: Porém nunca tirarei minha bondade dele, nem falharei em minha fidelidade.

versos.hebraico: לֹא־אֲחַלֵּ֥ל בְּרִיתִ֑י וּמוֹצָ֥א שְׂ֝פָתַ֗י לֹ֣א אֲשַׁנֶּֽה׃

controles.web: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.
controles.kjv: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.
controles.livre: Não quebrarei o meu pacto, e o que saiu dos meus lábios não mudarei.

versos.hebraico: אַ֭חַת נִשְׁבַּ֣עְתִּי בְקָדְשִׁ֑י אִֽם־לְדָוִ֥ד אֲכַזֵּֽב׃

controles.web: Once have I sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.
controles.kjv: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.
controles.livre: Uma vez jurei por minha Santidade, e nunca mentirei a Davi.

versos.hebraico: זַ֭רְעוֹ לְעוֹלָ֣ם יִהְיֶ֑ה וְכִסְא֖וֹ כַשֶּׁ֣מֶשׁ נֶגְדִּֽי׃

controles.web: His seed will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.
controles.kjv: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.
controles.livre: A semente dele durará para sempre, e o trono dele será como o sol perante mim.

versos.hebraico: כְּ֭יָרֵחַ יִכּ֣וֹן עוֹלָ֑ם וְעֵ֥ד בַּ֝שַּׁ֗חַק נֶאֱמָ֥ן סֶֽלָה׃

controles.web: It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.” Selah.
controles.kjv: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.
controles.livre: Assim como a lua, ele será confirmado para sempre; e a testemunha no céu é fiel. (Selá)

versos.hebraico: וְאַתָּ֣ה זָ֭נַחְתָּ וַתִּמְאָ֑ס הִ֝תְעַבַּ֗רְתָּ עִם־מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.
controles.kjv: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.
controles.livre: Porém tu te rebelaste, e o rejeitaste; ficaste irado contra o teu Ungido.

versos.hebraico: נֵ֭אַרְתָּה בְּרִ֣ית עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ חִלַּ֖לְתָּ לָאָ֣רֶץ נִזְרֽוֹ׃

controles.web: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.
controles.kjv: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.
controles.livre: Anulaste o pacto do teu servo; desonraste a coroa dele lançando-a contra a terra.

versos.hebraico: פָּרַ֥צְתָּ כָל־גְּדֵרֹתָ֑יו שַׂ֖מְתָּ מִבְצָרָ֣יו מְחִתָּה׃

controles.web: You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin.
controles.kjv: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.
controles.livre: Derrubaste todos os seus muros; quebraste suas fortificações.

versos.hebraico: שַׁ֭סֻּהוּ כָּל־עֹ֣בְרֵי דָ֑רֶךְ הָיָ֥ה חֶ֝רְפָּ֗ה לִשְׁכֵנָֽיו׃

controles.web: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.
controles.kjv: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.
controles.livre: Todos os que passam pelo caminho o despojaram; ele foi humilhado por seus vizinhos.

versos.hebraico: הֲ֭רִימוֹתָ יְמִ֣ין צָרָ֑יו הִ֝שְׂמַ֗חְתָּ כָּל־אוֹיְבָֽיו׃

controles.web: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.
controles.kjv: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.
controles.livre: Levantaste a mão direita de seus adversários; alegraste a todos os inimigos dele.

versos.hebraico: אַף־תָּ֭שִׁיב צ֣וּר חַרְבּ֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א הֲ֝קֵימֹת֗וֹ בַּמִּלְחָמָֽה׃

controles.web: Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven’t supported him in battle.
controles.kjv: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.
controles.livre: Também deixaste de afiar sua espada; e não o sustentaste na batalha.

versos.hebraico: הִשְׁבַּ֥תָּ מִטְּהָר֑וֹ וְ֝כִסְא֗וֹ לָאָ֥רֶץ מִגַּֽרְתָּה׃

controles.web: You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.
controles.kjv: Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.
controles.livre: Fizeste cessar sua formosura; e derrubaste seu trono à terra.

versos.hebraico: הִ֭קְצַרְתָּ יְמֵ֣י עֲלוּמָ֑יו הֶֽעֱטִ֨יתָ עָלָ֖יו בּוּשָׁ֣ה סֶֽלָה׃

controles.web: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame. Selah.
controles.kjv: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.
controles.livre: Encurtaste os dias de sua cidade; cobriste-o de vergonha. (Selá)

versos.hebraico: עַד־מָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה תִּסָּתֵ֣ר לָנֶ֑צַח תִּבְעַ֖ר כְּמוֹ־אֵ֣שׁ חֲמָתֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: How long, Yahweh? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?
controles.kjv: How long, Lord? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?
controles.livre: Até quando, SENHOR? Tu te esconderás para sempre? Arderá teu furor como o fogo?

versos.hebraico: זְכָר־אֲנִ֥י מֶה־חָ֑לֶד עַל־מַה־שָּׁ֝֗וְא בָּרָ֥אתָ כָל־בְּנֵי־אָדָֽם׃

controles.web: Remember how short my time is! For what vanity have you created all the children of men!
controles.kjv: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?
controles.livre: Lembra-te de que curta é minha vida; por que criarias em vão todos os filhos dos homens?

versos.hebraico: מִ֤י גֶ֣בֶר יִֽ֭חְיֶה וְלֹ֣א יִרְאֶה־מָּ֑וֶת יְמַלֵּ֨ט נַפְשׁ֖וֹ מִיַּד־שְׁא֣וֹל סֶֽלָה׃

controles.web: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.
controles.kjv: What man is he that liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.
controles.livre: Que homem vive, que não experimente a morte? Escaparia a alma dele do poder do mundo dos mortos? (Selá)

versos.hebraico: אַיֵּ֤ה׀ חֲסָדֶ֖יךָ הָרִאשֹׁנִ֥ים׀ אֲדֹנָ֑י נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתָּ לְ֝דָוִ֗ד בֶּאֱמוּנָתֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?
controles.kjv: Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, which thou swarest unto David in thy truth?
controles.livre: Senhor, onde estão as tuas bondades do passado, que juraste a Davi por tua fidelidade?

versos.hebraico: זְכֹ֣ר אֲ֭דֹנָי חֶרְפַּ֣ת עֲבָדֶ֑יךָ שְׂאֵתִ֥י בְ֝חֵיקִ֗י כָּל־רַבִּ֥ים עַמִּֽים׃

controles.web: Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,
controles.kjv: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; how I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty people;
controles.livre: Lembra-te, Senhor, da humilhação de teus servos, que eu trago em meu peito, causada por todos e grandes povos.

versos.hebraico: אֲשֶׁ֤ר חֵרְפ֖וּ אוֹיְבֶ֥יךָ׀ יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר חֵ֝רְפ֗וּ עִקְּב֥וֹת מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: With which your enemies have mocked, Yahweh, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.
controles.kjv: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O Lord; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.
controles.livre: Com humilhação os teus inimigos insultam, SENHOR, com a qual insultam os passos do teu ungido.

versos.hebraico: בָּר֖וּךְ יְהוָ֥ה לְ֝עוֹלָ֗ם אָ֘מֵ֥ן׀ וְאָמֵֽן׃

controles.web: Blessed be Yahweh forever more. Amen, and Amen.
controles.kjv: Blessed be the Lord for evermore. Amen, and Amen.
controles.livre: Bendito seja o SENHOR para todo o sempre. Amém, e Amém.
